name: Checkers
user_demand: Develop a Checkers (Draughts) game. Use an 8x8 board, alternate turns between two players, and apply standard capture and kinging rules. Prompt for moves in notation (e.g., from-to positions) and update the board state accordingly.

name: Sudoku
user_demand: Develop a classic Sudoku puzzle game that uses a 9x9 grid. Each row, column, and 3x3 subgrid must contain the digits 1 through 9 exactly once. The program should allow the player to input values for specific cells, check for mistakes, and confirm when the puzzle is completed.

name: TheCrossword
user_demand: Implement a crossword puzzle. Provide a grid of squares with clues for across and down entries. The user can enter words by specifying the clue number and direction. The application validates if letters match and confirms completion when all correct words are filled in.

name: DetectPalindromes
user_demand: develop a program that detects palindromes in a given text file

name: BudgetTracker
user_demand: Create a budget tracker to monitor expenses and savings

name: FibonacciNumbers
user_demand: write a program that generates Fibonacci numbers up to a given number

name: TicTacToe
user_demand: Design a tic-tac-toe game with a user-friendly interface, allowing two players to take turns and determining the winner. Use a standard 3x3 grid, track each player's moves. Players alternate placing X or O, and the game ends when a player wins or the board is full.

name: Gomoku
user_demand: Develop a standard Gomoku game. Implement it on a typical 15x15 board, where two players alternate placing black or white stones. A player wins by forming an unbroken row of five stones horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

name: Chess
user_demand: Design a chess game, allowing two players to take turns and determining the winner. It should be playable from Linux Terminal, and does not require me to access a dedicated UX or GUI platform, i.e. print the results on terminal at each stage and let me play it there by entering inputs (formal chess notation such as Ke8). Include standard chess features like castling, en passant, and pawn promotion. Enforce check and checkmate rules.

Design a standard 2048 game using a 4x4 grid. Players combine tiles by pressing arrow keys to slide them in one direction. Tiles with the same number merge into one, doubling the value. After each move, a new tile appears in a random empty cell. The game ends when no moves are possible. Track and display the current score and highest tile reached.

name: Tiny Rouge
user_demand: Design a roguelike game inspired by Tower of the Sorcerer. Use a fixed 80x80 grid map. The player character is controlled using W/A/S/D keys for movement (up, left, down, right). The character can move only on floor tiles and cannot pass through walls. The goal is to reach the door to proceed to the next level. The player encounters monsters; combat is resolved by subtracting the monster’s HP from the player's HP. HP is restored by 20–30 points when the player touches a treasure chest. Ensure there is always at least one valid path from the starting position to the door. Include a minimal UI to display the player's current HP and encountered monster stats.

name: Wordle
user_demand: Design a standard wordle game by providing a daily 5-letter English language word. The game should allow a player to take 6 turns to guess the word. Correct guess for each letter is colored by green (correct letter in correct position), grey for invalid letter, or yellow for correct letter in wrong position. It should be playable from Linux Terminal, and does not require me to access a dedicated UX or GUI platform, i.e. print the results on terminal at each stage and let me play it there by entering inputs. If the player guesses the word within the allowed number of attempts, they win. If not, the solution is revealed. Validate each guess for proper feedback.

name: Minesweeper
user_demand: Design a classic Minesweeper game with 3 levels of difficulty (beginner, intermediate, expert). The player uncovers cells by clicking on them. Numbers on uncovered cells indicate how many mines are adjacent. If a mine is uncovered, the player loses. The game displays the board with updated markings after each move. Include a flagging mechanism for suspected mines and a distinct visual for flagged cells.

name: ConnectionsNYT
user_demand: Develop a puzzle game where the player must group 16 words into four sets of four, based on hidden categories. The words are presented in a 4x4 grid, and players select four at a time to form a group. Correct groups are removed and revealed with a category and a color-coded difficulty (yellow, green, blue, purple). Incorrect guesses count as mistakes, with a maximum of four allowed. Only one correct solution exists, though words may appear to fit multiple categories. Include shuffle functionality and provide immediate feedback after each guess. A new puzzle is generated daily.

name: StrandsNYT
user_demand: Implement a version of the NYT Strands puzzle. Strands is a word search game within a 6x8 grid of letters which players use to uncover words falling under a theme. The board must be filled entirely to complete the puzzle - no words will overlap. Each game includes a challenge word called the "spangram" that touches two opposite sides of the board. Themed words will highlight blue; the spangram will highlight yellow. Words can be formed by connecting adjacent letters in any direction (vertically, horizontally, diagonally) and can change direction mid-word. Players can find non-theme words to earn hints. Every 3 non-theme words will unlock a hint! The puzzle must be fully completed by finding all theme words and filling the board.

name: SnakeGame
user_demand: Design a classic Snake game. The player controls a snake using directional inputs to move around the board and eat 'food' items. Each time the snake eats, it grows in length. The game ends if the snake collides with itself or the boundary. The board updates after each move. Show the current score based on food eaten, and consider offering multiple difficulty levels.

name: ConnectFour
user_demand: Implement a standard Connect Four game. Two players alternate placing discs into a seven-column, six-row grid. The objective is to form a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four discs. Players choose columns by typing a number, and the board updates after each move until a win or draw. Validate column choices and end the game when a winning line is detected or the grid is full.

name: TriviaQuiz
user_demand: Design a trivia quiz program that presents multiple-choice or short-answer questions on various topics. The user enters answers, and the game tracks the score. After answering all questions, the quiz displays the total correct answers. Allow configurable question banks and an option to display correct answers after the quiz.

name: DouDizhuPoker
user_demand: Implement Dou Dizhu (Chinese Poker) game for three players, one of whom is the 'landlord.' Cards must be played in valid combinations (singles, pairs, straights, etc.). The objective is to be the first to run out of cards or prevent the landlord from doing so, following standard Dou Dizhu rules. Include the bidding phase to determine the landlord, and enforce the pass-or-beat logic for played combinations.

name: Tetris
user_demand: Create a Tetris game. Tetrominoes fall from the top, and the player can move or rotate them before they land. Completed lines are cleared, and scoring increases accordingly. The game ends when no more pieces can be placed. The board updates after each move or drop. Include all seven standard Tetromino shapes and consider increasing drop speed as the game progresses.

name: ReversiOthello
user_demand: Develop a Reversi (Othello) board game. Two players alternate placing discs on an 8x8 grid, flipping the opponent’s discs that lie between the newly placed piece and existing pieces of the same color. The game ends when the board is full or no valid moves remain. The program should automatically identify valid moves, flip discs, and display the current score.

name: StrandsGame
user_demand: Design a word-segmentation puzzle named 'Strands.' Provide multiple strands of text that the player must combine to form meaningful words or phrases. The program verifies valid strand formations and confirms completion once all strands are correctly merged. Similar to NYT Strands, offer feedback on valid merges.

name: MonopolyGo
user_demand: Create a simplified version of Monopoly Go! with basic board mechanics: rolling dice, moving around properties, buying them, collecting rent, and handling chance events. Track player money and property ownership. Display relevant game information and prompt each player for decisions. Implement essential rules for jail, free parking, and simplified chance cards.

name: EpisodeChooseYourStory
user_demand: Develop an interactive storytelling game. Present narrative segments and branching choices. Player decisions influence subsequent story events. Track variables such as relationships or items that alter possible endings. Provide users with different paths based on choices. Store branches in a structured way and use conditional checks to shape the storyline.

name: CandyCrush
user_demand: Implement a match-3 puzzle game reminiscent of Candy Crush. Represent the board and let users swap adjacent candies to form matches of three or more. Matches are cleared, new candies appear, and scoring is tracked. The board updates after each valid move. Incorporate chain reactions when candies fall and possibly track moves or time-based constraints.

name: FlappyBird
user_demand: Build a Flappy Bird clone. The player presses a key to 'flap' and keep the bird from falling. Randomly generated vertical gaps in 'pipes' appear. Each successful pass increases the score. The game ends if the bird collides with a pipe or the ground. Gradually adjust difficulty by varying gap sizes and pipe speeds.

name: TextBasedSpaceInvaders
user_demand: Program a simplified Space Invaders game. The player controls a ship at the bottom of the screen and can move horizontally and fire shots to destroy descending alien rows. The game ends if aliens reach the bottom or the player defeats all aliens. Add multiple alien rows, a limited number of lives, and score tracking.

name: GoldMiner
user_demand: Design a Gold Miner game. A claw moves back and forth, and the player times a grab to collect gold or other objects. Each object has a value and takes time to reel in. The level ends when time runs out or the minimum gold value is met. Display the position of the claw and objects, updating after each grab. Introduce ascending difficulty with more obstacles or tighter time limits.

name: Pong
user_demand: Develop a two-player Pong game. Each player controls a vertical paddle, moving up and down to bounce a ball back. The ball bounces between the two paddles and off the top and bottom edges. Players score a point when the opponent misses the ball. Incorporate a winning score threshold and reset the ball after each point.

name: Mastermind
user_demand: Implement the classic Mastermind code-breaking game. The computer selects a hidden sequence of colors (or digits), and the player attempts to guess it within a set number of tries. After each guess, show feedback regarding correct color and correct position. Distinguish between exact matches and partial color matches, and provide a clear win/lose outcome.

name: CLI_Text_File_Word_Counter
user_demand: Create a CLI tool that takes a text file path as input and outputs the total word count. The tool should handle basic punctuation and count sequences of alphanumeric characters as words. Output the count to the console.

name: Directory_Tree_Generator_CLI
user_demand: Develop a CLI utility that generates a visual tree structure of a given directory. The output should represent directories and files, indenting subdirectories and their contents. Allow specifying a maximum depth for the tree.

name: Simple_CSV_Data_Processor_CLI
user_demand: Build a CLI program that reads a CSV file, allows the user to specify a column name, and then prints all unique values from that column. The program should handle CSV files with headers.

name: CLI_Unit_Converter_Temperature
user_demand: Write a CLI tool to convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. The user should input the value, the source unit (e.g., C, F, K), and the target unit. Display the converted temperature.

name: Basic_Network_Ping_Tool_CLI
user_demand: Implement a basic CLI network ping tool. The user provides an IP address or hostname, and the tool sends a configurable number of ICMP echo requests, displaying the round-trip time for each and a summary.

name: CLI_JSON_File_Viewer
user_demand: Create a CLI application to view the contents of a JSON file in a human-readable, indented format. The tool should take a file path as input and print the formatted JSON to the standard output.

name: System_Resource_Monitor_CLI_Basic
user_demand: Develop a simple CLI tool that displays basic system resource usage: CPU percentage, memory usage (total, used, free), and disk space (total, used, free for a specified partition or root). Update the display every few seconds or on command.

name: CLI_Task_Scheduler_Simple
user_demand: Build a CLI task scheduler that allows users to add tasks with a specific execution time (e.g., HH:MM on a given date). The tool should execute a specified command when the time is reached. Store tasks in a simple text file.

name: Log_File_Analyzer_CLI_Errors
user_demand: Write a CLI program to analyze a log file (e.g., Apache access log, system log). The user specifies the log file and a pattern (e.g., ERROR, 404). The tool should count and display lines containing the pattern.

name: CLI_Image_Metadata_Extractor
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to extract and display basic metadata (e.g., resolution, format, creation date if available) from image files (JPEG, PNG). The user provides the image file path.

name: Simple_File_Encryption_Decryption_CLI
user_demand: Develop a CLI utility for simple file encryption and decryption using a symmetric algorithm (e.g., AES with a user-provided password). The tool should take input file, output file, password, and mode (encrypt/decrypt) as arguments.

name: CLI_Markdown_to_HTML_Converter_Basic
user_demand: Build a basic CLI Markdown to HTML converter. It should support common Markdown syntax like headers, bold, italics, lists, and links, converting a .md file to a .html file.

name: CLI_Currency_Converter_Static_Rates
user_demand: Write a CLI currency converter that uses a predefined, static set of exchange rates (e.g., stored in a configuration file). The user inputs an amount, source currency, and target currency.

name: CLI_Random_Quote_Generator
user_demand: Create a CLI tool that displays a random quote from a predefined list of quotes stored in a text file. Each execution should show a different quote.

name: CLI_Directory_Size_Calculator
user_demand: Develop a CLI utility to calculate and display the total size of a directory and its subdirectories. The output should be human-readable (e.g., KB, MB, GB).

name: CLI_File_Duplicate_Finder_Basic
user_demand: Build a CLI program to find duplicate files within a specified directory based on their content (e.g., using MD5 or SHA256 hashes). List the paths of duplicate files.

name: CLI_Weather_Fetcher_API
user_demand: Write a CLI tool that fetches and displays the current weather for a given city using a public weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap). The user provides the city name.

name: CLI_Stock_Price_Checker_API_Basic
user_demand: Create a CLI application to check the current stock price for a given ticker symbol using a public financial API (e.g., Alpha Vantage, IEX Cloud). Display the current price and change.

name: CLI_URL_Shortener_Client
user_demand: Develop a CLI client for a URL shortening service (e.g., TinyURL API or similar). The user provides a long URL, and the tool outputs the shortened URL.

name: CLI_Base64_Encoder_Decoder
user_demand: Build a CLI tool to encode and decode strings using Base64. The user provides the input string and specifies whether to encode or decode.

name: CLI_Checksum_Calculator_MD5_SHA
user_demand: Write a CLI utility to calculate and display the MD5 and SHA256 checksums of a given file. The user provides the file path.

name: CLI_Timer_Countdown_Tool
user_demand: Create a CLI timer and countdown tool. For the timer, it counts up from zero. For countdown, the user specifies a duration (e.g., 5m, 1h30s), and it counts down, notifying when finished.

name: CLI_Simple_Contact_Book
user_demand: Develop a simple CLI contact book. Allow users to add, view, search, and delete contacts (name, phone number, email). Store contacts in a plain text or CSV file.

name: CLI_Password_Strength_Checker
user_demand: Build a CLI tool that checks the strength of a given password. It should evaluate criteria like length, use of uppercase/lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters, providing a strength score or rating.

name: CLI_Text_Case_Converter_Tool
user_demand: Write a CLI utility to convert text to various cases: uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case. The tool takes a string as input or reads from a file.

name: CLI_IP_Address_Lookup_Tool
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to look up IP address information (e.g., geolocation, ISP) using a public IP geolocation API (e.g., ip-api.com). The user provides an IP address.

name: CLI_File_Archiver_Zip_Basic
user_demand: Develop a basic CLI file archiver that can create and extract ZIP archives. It should support adding files/directories to a ZIP and extracting contents from a ZIP file.

name: CLI_Code_Line_Counter_By_Extension
user_demand: Build a CLI program that counts the total lines of code in a directory, categorized by file extension (e.g., .py, .js, .c). Ignore comments and blank lines if possible.

name: CLI_Simple_Web_Scraper_Title_Extractor
user_demand: Write a simple CLI web scraper that takes a URL and extracts and prints the title of the web page. Handle basic HTTP requests.

name: CLI_Music_Playlist_Manager_Text_Based
user_demand: Create a CLI music playlist manager. Allow users to create playlists, add songs (song title, artist, album - stored as text), remove songs, and view playlists. Store data in text files.

name: CLI_Regex_Tester_Tool
user_demand: Develop a CLI regex tester. The user provides a regular expression and a test string. The tool indicates if the string matches the regex and can optionally show matched groups.

name: CLI_System_Uptime_Display
user_demand: Build a CLI tool that displays the system uptime (how long the system has been running). Utilize system commands like `uptime` on Linux.

name: CLI_File_Permissions_Changer_Numeric
user_demand: Write a CLI utility to change file permissions using numeric (octal) notation (e.g., 755, 644) similar to `chmod`. The user provides the permission mode and file/directory path.

name: CLI_Process_Killer_By_Name
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to find and kill processes by their name. The tool should list matching processes and ask for confirmation before killing.

name: CLI_Text_File_Sorter_Alphabetical
user_demand: Develop a CLI program that sorts the lines of a text file alphabetically or reverse-alphabetically and outputs the result to a new file or standard output.

name: CLI_Number_Guessing_Game_CLI
user_demand: Build a CLI number guessing game. The program generates a random number, and the user tries to guess it, receiving hints (higher/lower) until they guess correctly.

name: CLI_Hangman_Game_Text_Based
user_demand: Write a CLI Hangman game. The program selects a random word, and the player guesses letters. Display the word with guessed letters filled in and track incorrect guesses.

name: CLI_Todo_List_Manager_Simple
user_demand: Create a simple CLI to-do list manager. Allow users to add tasks, view tasks, mark tasks as complete, and remove tasks. Store tasks in a text file.

name: CLI_Calendar_Display_Month_Year
user_demand: Develop a CLI tool that displays a calendar for a given month and year. The user inputs the month (numeric or name) and year.

name: CLI_Simple_Firewall_Rule_Adder_iptables
user_demand: Build a CLI utility that provides a simplified interface to add basic firewall rules using `iptables` (Linux). For example, allow or block a specific port. Requires sudo privileges.

name: CLI_File_Content_Searcher_grep_like
user_demand: Write a CLI program that searches for a given string/pattern within all text files in a specified directory and its subdirectories (similar to `grep -r`). Display matching lines and filenames.

name: CLI_Morse_Code_Translator
user_demand: Create a CLI Morse code translator. It should translate English text to Morse code and Morse code (dots and dashes) back to English text.

name: CLI_Unit_Converter_Length
user_demand: Develop a CLI unit converter for lengths (e.g., meters to feet, inches to cm). User inputs value, source unit, and target unit.

name: CLI_Unit_Converter_Weight
user_demand: Build a CLI unit converter for weights/mass (e.g., kilograms to pounds, grams to ounces). User inputs value, source unit, and target unit.

name: CLI_Simple_HTTP_Server_Static_Files
user_demand: Write a simple CLI HTTP server that serves static files (HTML, CSS, JS, images) from a specified local directory. Listens on a configurable port.

name: CLI_QR_Code_Generator_Text
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to generate a QR code from a given text string or URL. Output the QR code as an ASCII art representation in the terminal or save it as an image file.

name: CLI_File_Splitter_By_Size
user_demand: Develop a CLI utility to split a large file into smaller parts of a specified size (e.g., 10MB chunks). Name the output parts sequentially.

name: CLI_File_Joiner_From_Split_Parts
user_demand: Build a CLI program to join multiple file parts (created by a file splitter) back into a single original file. The user specifies the first part name.

name: CLI_Text_Difference_Tool_Basic
user_demand: Write a basic CLI text difference tool (like a simplified `diff`). It takes two text file paths as input and highlights the lines that are different.

name: CLI_System_Info_Display_Basic_Linux
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to display basic system information on Linux, such as OS version, kernel version, CPU model, and total RAM. Use system files in /proc or commands like `uname`.

name: CLI_Log_Rotator_Simple
user_demand: Develop a simple CLI log rotator. It renames an existing log file (e.g., app.log to app.log.1) and creates a new empty app.log. Optionally, compress old logs and delete logs older than N days.

name: CLI_Clipboard_Manager_Text_Only
user_demand: Build a CLI clipboard manager for text only. Allow users to copy text to this internal clipboard, paste from it, and view its history. (Manages its own clipboard, not the system one directly without extra tools).

name: CLI_Dictionary_Lookup_Offline_Basic
user_demand: Write a CLI dictionary lookup tool that uses a local, offline dictionary file (e.g., a plain text file with word:definition format). User inputs a word, tool displays definition.

name: CLI_Thesaurus_Lookup_Offline_Basic
user_demand: Create a CLI thesaurus lookup tool using a local, offline thesaurus file. User inputs a word, tool displays synonyms and antonyms if available.

name: CLI_File_Watcher_Changes_Basic
user_demand: Develop a CLI file watcher that monitors a specified file or directory for changes (creation, modification, deletion) and prints a notification to the console.

name: CLI_Directory_Synchronizer_One_Way_Basic
user_demand: Build a basic one-way directory synchronizer. It copies new or modified files from a source directory to a target directory. Does not delete files from target if removed from source.

name: CLI_Simple_Backup_Script_Creator
user_demand: Write a CLI script creator for simple backups. User specifies source directories and a target backup location. The script (e.g., shell script using `rsync` or `tar`) is generated.

name: CLI_Text_Based_Adventure_Game_Engine
user_demand: Create a CLI engine for a simple text-based adventure game. Load game data (rooms, user_demands, items, choices) from a JSON or YAML file. Player navigates by typing commands.

name: CLI_Sudoku_Solver_Basic
user_demand: Develop a CLI Sudoku solver. Takes a partially filled 9x9 Sudoku grid as input (e.g., from a file or direct input) and prints the solved grid. Implement a backtracking algorithm.

name: CLI_Maze_Generator_Text_Output
user_demand: Build a CLI maze generator that outputs a maze as text characters (e.g., '#' for walls, ' ' for paths) to the console. Allow specifying maze dimensions.

name: CLI_Password_Vault_Simple_Encrypted
user_demand: Write a simple CLI password vault. Store website/service names, usernames, and passwords encrypted in a local file. Use a master password to encrypt/decrypt the vault.

name: CLI_Git_Branch_Cleaner_Inactive
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to help clean up local Git branches by listing branches that have been merged into the main/master branch and are inactive (old commit date), offering an option to delete them.

name: CLI_Docker_Container_Manager_Basic_Ops
user_demand: Develop a basic CLI Docker container manager. List running/all containers, start/stop containers by ID/name, and view logs of a container. (Assumes Docker is installed and user has permissions).

name: CLI_SSH_Alias_Manager
user_demand: Build a CLI SSH alias manager. Allow users to add, list, and remove SSH connection aliases (hostname, user, port, key file) stored in a configuration file, making it easier to connect.

name: CLI_Network_Speed_Tester_Basic
user_demand: Write a CLI network speed tester that measures download and upload speed against a public test server (e.g., using speedtest-cli or by downloading/uploading a file from a known server).

name: CLI_File_Renamer_Bulk_Pattern
user_demand: Create a CLI file renamer that can rename multiple files in a directory based on a specified pattern (e.g., add prefix, replace substring, add sequential numbers).

name: CLI_Image_Resizer_Basic_Proportions
user_demand: Develop a basic CLI image resizer. Takes an image file, target width or height, and resizes it while maintaining aspect ratio. Save the output to a new file.

name: CLI_Audio_File_Tag_Editor_Basic_MP3
user_demand: Build a CLI audio file tag editor for MP3 files (basic ID3 tags). Allow viewing and modifying tags like title, artist, album, year. Requires a library for MP3 tag manipulation.

name: CLI_Video_to_GIF_Converter_Basic_ffmpeg
user_demand: Write a CLI tool to convert a short video file segment (e.g., first 5 seconds) into an animated GIF. Requires `ffmpeg` to be installed.

name: CLI_PDF_Text_Extractor_Basic
user_demand: Create a CLI PDF text extractor. Takes a PDF file path and extracts all text content, printing it to standard output or saving to a text file. (May use a library like pdftotext).

name: CLI_RSS_Feed_Reader_Simple
user_demand: Develop a simple CLI RSS feed reader. User provides an RSS feed URL, and the tool fetches and displays the latest article titles and links.

name: CLI_JSON_to_CSV_Converter
user_demand: Build a CLI tool to convert a JSON file to a CSV file. Handle nested JSON by flattening or allowing user to specify fields. User provides input JSON and output CSV paths.

name: CLI_CSV_to_JSON_Converter
user_demand: Write a CLI utility to convert a CSV file to a JSON file. Each row in the CSV becomes a JSON object. User provides input CSV and output JSON paths.

name: CLI_YAML_File_Validator
user_demand: Create a CLI YAML file validator. Takes a YAML file path and checks if its syntax is valid. Print success or error messages with line numbers if possible.

name: CLI_XML_File_Pretty_Printer
user_demand: Develop a CLI XML file pretty printer. Takes an XML file and outputs a well-formatted, indented version to the console or a new file.

name: CLI_HTML_Tag_Stripper
user_demand: Build a CLI tool to strip all HTML tags from an HTML file or string input, leaving only the plain text content.

name: CLI_Simple_Data_Plotter_Text_Based
user_demand: Write a simple CLI data plotter that takes a list of numbers (e.g., from a file or stdin) and generates a basic text-based bar chart or line graph in the terminal.

name: CLI_Pomodoro_Timer
user_demand: Create a CLI Pomodoro timer. Allows users to start a 25-minute work session followed by a 5-minute break, with configurable durations and notifications.

name: CLI_Personal_Journal_Encrypted
user_demand: Develop a CLI personal journal application. Entries are timestamped and can be encrypted with a user-provided password. Store entries in a local file.

name: CLI_Recipe_Manager_Text_Based
user_demand: Build a CLI recipe manager. Allow users to add recipes (name, ingredients, instructions), search for recipes by name or ingredient, and view recipe details. Store data in text or JSON files.

name: CLI_Book_Library_Manager_Text_Based
user_demand: Write a CLI book library manager. Users can add books (title, author, ISBN), list all books, search by title or author, and mark books as read/unread. Store data locally.

name: CLI_Flashcard_Study_Tool
user_demand: Create a CLI flashcard study tool. Users can create decks of flashcards (front: question/term, back: answer/definition). The tool presents cards for review.

name: CLI_Typing_Speed_Tester
user_demand: Develop a CLI typing speed tester. Presents a random paragraph of text, and the user types it. Calculates words per minute (WPM) and accuracy.

name: CLI_Simple_Chat_Client_Local_Network
user_demand: Build a simple CLI chat client for a local network. Connects to a corresponding chat server. Allows sending and receiving text messages.

name: CLI_Simple_Chat_Server_Local_Network
user_demand: Write a simple CLI chat server for a local network. Listens for connections from chat clients and broadcasts messages to all connected clients.

name: CLI_File_Transfer_Tool_Local_Network_Basic
user_demand: Create a basic CLI file transfer tool for a local network. Allows sending a file from one machine (client) to another (server) running a corresponding receiver script.

name: CLI_System_Log_Monitor_Keywords
user_demand: Develop a CLI system log monitor that tails a specified log file (e.g., /var/log/syslog) and highlights lines containing user-defined keywords.

name: CLI_Disk_Space_Analyzer_CLI_Visual
user_demand: Build a CLI disk space analyzer that provides a more detailed or visual (text-based) breakdown of disk usage within a directory, showing largest files/folders.

name: CLI_CPU_Usage_Monitor_Per_Process_Basic
user_demand: Write a CLI CPU usage monitor that shows CPU usage per process, similar to a simplified `top` command, updating periodically. Focus on a specific process if a PID is given.

name: CLI_Memory_Usage_Monitor_Basic
user_demand: Create a CLI memory usage monitor that displays overall system memory usage and optionally lists top memory-consuming processes. (e.g. using /proc/meminfo and /proc/[pid]/status).

name: CLI_Environment_Variable_Manager
user_demand: Develop a CLI environment variable manager. Allow users to list, set (for current session or persistently via shell profile), and unset environment variables easily.

name: CLI_Cronjob_Generator_Simple

name: CLI_Text_File_Line_Number_Adder
user_demand: Write a CLI utility to add line numbers to a text file. The output can be to a new file or standard output.

name: CLI_Duplicate_Line_Remover_From_File
user_demand: Create a CLI tool to remove duplicate lines from a text file, preserving the order of the first occurrence. Output to a new file or standard output.

name: CLI_Text_File_Column_Extractor
user_demand: Develop a CLI program to extract specific columns from a CSV or space-delimited text file. User specifies column numbers or headers.

name: CLI_Simple_Spell_Checker_Dictionary_Based
user_demand: Build a simple CLI spell checker that takes a text file or string input and checks words against a local dictionary file, highlighting potential misspellings.

name: CLI_Language_Translator_API_Client_Basic
user_demand: Write a basic CLI client for a language translation API (e.g., Google Translate API with a free tier or other). User inputs text and target language, tool outputs translation.

name: CLI_Code_Snippet_Manager
user_demand: Create a CLI code snippet manager. Allow users to save, categorize (e.g., by language), search, and retrieve frequently used code snippets. Store snippets in local files.

name: CLI_Markdown_Table_Generator_CSV_Input
user_demand: Develop a CLI tool that generates a Markdown table from a CSV file input. The first row of the CSV is treated as the header.
